title: Web and Internet Fundamentals
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Web and Internet Fundamentals.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Web and Internet Fundamentals topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.
